recognize_zh: 左下方是由小淋巴球組成、界線清楚的反應性淋巴濾泡，其周圍的淋巴竇內可見一條淡粉紅色帶狀區域，充滿胞質淡嗜酸、核卵圓帶核溝的蘭格漢斯細胞並夾雜少數嗜酸性球，符合濾泡周竇的 LCH 侵犯。
features: Well-circumscribed lymphoid follicle/mantle of densely packed small lymphocytes at bottom left
Perifollicular sinus band of pale eosinophilic lesional cells running diagonally from upper left to right
Lesional cells with moderate pale cytoplasm and oval, grooved or folded nuclei with fine chromatin
Scattered eosinophils and small lymphocytes admixed within the sinus infiltrate
Additional lymphoid tissue at the upper right; no significant atypia or necrosis
describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained section of lymph node at higher power shows a reactive lymphoid follicle at the bottom left surrounded by a perifollicular sinus that is expanded by pale histiocytoid cells. The lesional cells have moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval, grooved or folded nuclei with fine chromatin, admixed with scattered eosinophils and small lymphocytes. No marked atypia or necrosis is seen. Findings are consistent with sinusoidal involvement by Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Rosai-Dorfman sinus histiocytes are larger with round nuclei, prominent nucleoli and emperipolesis, and are CD1a/langerin negative.
Reactive sinus histiocytes have bland round-to-oval nuclei without grooves or eosinophils and are CD1a negative.
Dermatopathic change forms paracortical nodules with melanin pigment rather than sinus-confined sheets.
